title: Organic Pest Control Secrets Revealed
reason: The video describes a 80-year-old farmer's method of pest control without pesticides.

tasks.task: Describe the organic pest control methods used by the farmer.

subtasks.text: Observe the method of using one orange peel soaked in water to treat small flying insects.

frames.caption: The video shows a tomato plant with various stages of ripeness, with some red and some green tomatoes.
A video shows a person pouring water into a glass filled with orange peels to treat small flying insects.
A person is pouring white vinegar into a glass.

subtasks.text: Notice the use of white vinegar mixed with dish soap to deal with sticky bugs.

frames.caption: A person is using dish soap to treat a plant with sticky bugs.
A hand is holding a bundle of green grass with the text "point three laundry detergent" overlaid.

subtasks.text: Highlight the process of diluting laundry detergent with water to combat red spiders.

frames.caption: A person is spraying a plant with a dilute solution to combat red spiders.
A pot of soup with text indicating it's point four boiled Sichuan pepper water.

subtasks.text: See the method of boiling Sichuan pepper to make a solution to eliminate beetles.

frames.caption: The video shows a close-up of a plant with visible damage, and a caption suggests using 5 chili and garlic water.

subtasks.text: Observe the mixture of chili and garlic water to deal with cabbage worms.

frames.caption: A bowl contains a mixture of green vegetables and garlic, with water being poured over it.
The video frame shows a close-up of a plant with holes in its leaves, with the text "point 6 Artemisia mugwort" overlaid.

subtasks.text: Pay attention to the boiling of Artemisia mugwort in water to prevent ground beetles.

frames.caption: A pot of water is being boiled with a stick to prevent ground beetles.
The video shows a close-up of lettuce leaves in a garden.
